description: Liquid glass for Omarchy’s bar, menu, panels, notifications, lock input and windows. The tray button opens explicit setup first, then Vetro Glass and repair controls. Native engine build required; uninstall Vetro before removing this launcher.

barWidget.description: Set up Vetro, tune its glass, or turn it on and off.
